messages.en:
{07 16 00}There's nothing more sad
than mumbling to myself
at night.
{07 14 00}So, {01 00 00 0a 00}lately I try to talk to
my {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}fossil.
{07 16 00}Technically, it was alive,
though it was a long time
ago{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 1b 00}I don't have all the parts
yet, {01 00 00 05 00}so it's still kind of a
one-way conversation.
